resources.string: Aevum collects location data to enable place detection (geofences), automatic drive detection, detection of walks and bike rides, and the place timeline — even when the app is closed or not in use.
These features use your location in the background:
Place detection (geofences): entering or leaving places such as home, work or the gym automatically starts or stops activities.
Drive detection: car trips are detected automatically and recorded with their route.
Detection of walks and bike rides: your journeys are recorded as activities automatically.
Place timeline and unknown places: Aevum keeps a history of the places you have been to.

These features are meant to work without any action from you. Place changes happen while your phone is in your pocket and Aevum is not open. Without background access you would have to open the app yourself every time you enter or leave a place — the automation would no longer be automatic.
What happens to your location data

All location data is stored exclusively on your device. There is no Aevum server, no user accounts, no advertising and no sharing with third parties. You can revoke access at any time in the system settings.
Aevum collects location data for place detection, drive detection, journey detection and the place timeline — even when the app is closed or not in use. All data stays on your device.
